001: Did you spend the whole day on your phone again?
Yeah, I ended up getting lost in the videos, I didn't even see the time pass.
I have that same problem with the photo app.
Really? Good to know I'm not the only one.
But we need to control ourselves a little.
You're right, I'll try to limit my usage today.
002: Did you see the post Fernanda made in the group?
I did, but I thought the discussion got a bit heated.
Yeah, people don't really respect other people's opinions.
That bothers me a lot, that's why I prefer to just read.
Me too, but sometimes I end up commenting.
Better to avoid it, right? Online arguments rarely end well.
003: Why don't you post more pictures of your trips?
I've been preferring to keep my life more private.
I get it, but you have beautiful pictures.
Thanks! Maybe I'll share some in the future.
If you post, let me know and I'll comment.
Sure thing, I'll let you know.
004: Do you take part in any online community?
I'm in a running group, we meet every Sunday.
That's cool! How did you find that group?
It was through a recommendation from a friend who already ran with them.
And do you only talk over the internet?
No, we also arrange in-person meetups, it's really fun.
005: Did you see how many likes Rafael's video got?
I did, but to me that doesn't mean much.
What do you mean? Isn't it a sign that the content is good?
Not always, sometimes people like it without even watching.
That makes sense, I had never thought about it that way.
Yeah, better to focus on quality rather than the numbers.
006: Do you still use that messaging app?
I do, but now only to talk to my family.
I ended up leaving several groups, it was exhausting.
I get it, some groups only send useless messages.
Not to mention the chain messages, right? That really annoys me.
For sure, I mute everything that isn't important.
007: Have you ever bought something from an ad on social media?
Yeah, once I bought a pair of headphones that never arrived.
Wow, that's so frustrating! And did you get a refund?
I did, but it was a huge headache.
That's why I prefer to buy only from well-known stores.
Good call, there are a lot of scams out there.
008: I follow a few, but only the ones who teach something useful.
I used to follow a bunch, but I got tired of seeing ads.
Yeah, these days everything is sponsored content.
Plus a lot of it is way too superficial.
Exactly, I prefer content that actually adds value.
009: Have you ever blocked someone on social media?
Yeah, a coworker who wouldn't stop tagging me.
And there was no problem afterwards?
No, he didn't even notice, actually.
That's good, sometimes it's the only solution.
For sure, we need to protect our own peace.
010: Do you think social media brings people together or pushes them apart?
I think it depends a lot on how we use it.
What do you mean? Can you explain a bit more?
If you use it to talk to friends, it brings people together.
And when someone just keeps scrolling through the feed?
Then they drift away from real life, without even realizing it.
